- The tint is a Beer's-law volume (materials.py:1179-1229; Volume Absorption at :1221), so light carried along the acrylic is absorbed along its length.
- The gain ranks by clarity: Fog, then Acid, Dust, Ice, then Ember and Haze, then Smoke and Poison.
- With the shadow shortcut cut in 6 materials, light reaches the inside only by refracting. So the added light is caustic light, which light C turns on by design (render.py:285-286).
